functions.name: TRANSLATE
functions.description: Translate text using switchable Bing or Google translation engines.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text or cell reference to translate (e.g. A1).

parameters.name: targetLang
parameters.description: Target language code (default: zh-CN, e.g. en, ja, ko).

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: Translation engine: bing or google (default: bing).
